cues.zh: 假設有一個大型影像資料集，例如 ImageNet。

cues.en: And then what if we could use the patterns in that neural network that is trained on a million images, but then customize those patterns for our own problem, specifically for food vision many.

cues.en: So that's an example of transfer learning.
cues.zh: 這就是遷移學習的例子。

cues.en: You're taking what one model has learned.
cues.zh: 取用一個模型學到的東西。

cues.en: For example, a computer vision model on a large dataset like Image Net and then customizing it for your own use case.
cues.zh: 例如，在 ImageNet 這種大型資料集訓練的電腦視覺模型，再針對自己的用途調整。

cues.zh: 不過這裡整體的模式，遷移學習的主要重點，是取用模型在某個資料集，通常是大型資料

cues.en: And of course, if we leveraged a working neural network architecture, we can also leverage the existing learned patterns on data similar to our own.
